howto: Pick a district and press DROP IN. Drag anywhere to steer the hole; it swallows things smaller than itself.
Fill the quota bar before the clock runs out. Stars sit at half the quota, the quota and 1.8 times the quota.
Bigger hole, bigger things: the size panel shows what you can swallow next.
Spend coins on UPGRADES (wide mouth, slipstream, overtime, gravity well, greed) and on new HOLES (rim colours).
tips: Bigger things are worth more: the size panel shows what you can swallow next.
Each district has its own payout multiplier and rivals; districts unlock with coins.
A daily goal pays coins once a day; the week stamps light on consecutive days.

controls.keyboard: WASD or the arrow keys steer, or hold the mouse button and the hole rolls toward the pointer. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Hold a finger on the screen and the hole rolls toward it. The pause button is top right.

difficulty: Each district is a harder band: more rival holes (1 in Suburb up to 5 in The Void) and a bigger quota. Rivals are sized from your own mass, so they keep pace as you grow: harmless in Suburb, hunters by Skyline. A wave of bigger props lands every 12 seconds, and coin upgrades make later runs easier.

cheats.effect: Start every run three times as wide

settings.quality: Hub > GRAPHICS: HIGH / LOW (Low renders at 1x resolution with no shadows, a shorter draw distance, no skyline or street lamps and fewer particles)

features.one-tap-start: DROP IN on the hub starts a run in the chosen district
features.instant-restart: RUN AGAIN on the results card, and Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: BEST RUN tile in the hub, and a ★ BEST mark on the results score
features.tutorial-card: First run: an animated STEER THE HOLE card; the clock waits until you have swallowed 3 things, then a GROW card follows. Skippable, and replayed from How to play
features.results: Result card with stars, score, coins earned, rank and goals
features.levels: Districts unlock with coins and show their star rating on the title
features.stars: Up to three stars per district run (half quota, quota, 1.8x quota)
features.unlocks: Upgrades with ten levels each and nine hole rims unlocked by stars, coins, level or day streak
features.daily-goal: One seeded daily goal (score, eat, runs or cars) with a coin reward, week stamps and a day streak
